Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Record Class LightingCapabilities

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ke.ric.renderer.api.LightingCapabilities
Record Components:
supported - whether creative lighting and primary visibility controls are supported
maxLights - maximum virtual lights per pass
maxShadowLights - maximum shadow-casting virtual lights per pass
maxRange - maximum light range in blocks
maxIntensity - maximum artistic light intensity
public record LightingCapabilities(boolean supported, int maxLights, int maxShadowLights, double maxRange, double maxIntensity) extends Record
Immutable provider limits for explicit lighting and primary-camera visibility controls. These are capability limits, not a claim about frame rate. A request must fit every advertised limit; unsupported providers reject controls rather than ignoring them.
